items.title: Ladd McConkey: Ruled out for Monday's game
items.text:
McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jameson Williams: Four grabs in win over Pats
items.text:
Williams caught four of seven targets for 50 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Two trips to end zone in Week 10 win
items.text:
St. Brown caught four of five targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Geno Smith: Heads to medical tent Sunday
items.text:
Smith exited Sunday's game against the Bills and headed to the blue medical tent after absorbing a hard hit, Connor Hughes of SNY reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Massive numbers in Week 10 romp
items.text:
Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 99 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Travis Kelce: Back in Sunday's game
items.text:
Kelce (ankle) has returned to Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the team's official site reports.
